title: xeraea holosericea
intro: Xeraea holosericea, commonly known as Peruvian maca, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. It is known for its adaptogenic properties and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being. Peruvian maca is believed to have several health benefits, including improving fertility, boosting energy, and reducing symptoms of menopause, due to its therapeutic actions such as hormone regulation and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Peruvian maca include macamides, macaridin, and macaenes, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal effects.
